pel0: Muscles take time to strengthen: practise regularly for at least 3 months. The UK national health guideline from NICE also recommends a pelvic floor programme lasting at least 3 months, supervised by a physiotherapist, for women who leak urine when coughing or straining or who have mixed incontinence. If at first you can only hold for a few seconds or manage a few repetitions, that’s fine; keep going and build up gradually.
